create_train_state: create a JAX training state with parameters, optimizer, EMA params, and learning rate schedule for a Flax model
train_and_evaluate: run a distributed JAX training and evaluation loop with checkpointing, logging, and periodic sampling on image or text datasets
train_step: perform a single JIT-compiled training step with optional microbatch gradient accumulation and EMA parameter updates
evaluate: evaluate a trained model on a dataset and return aggregated metrics like loss across multiple eval batches
load_last_state: load the last checkpointed training state from an Orbax checkpoint directory for resuming training
